bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected rain relief and water clearance operations in Velachery.
Rotary International honoured 113 teachers at the Aasaan awards event held in Velachery.
Heavy rains left Velachery AGS Colony under knee-deep water with boats kept ready for rescue.
Velachery and T Nagar faced severe waterlogging following heavy intermittent rainfall overnight.
The bodies of two schoolboys who drowned in Puzhal Lake were recovered by authorities.
Heavy rain caused water to pool like a pond on Taramani main road, causing traffic jams.
The Greater Chennai Corporation kept 220 special relief camps ready following northeast monsoon rains.
The government invited tenders for the renovation and desilting of Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals.
Heavy rains flooded residential areas and railway subways in Ponneri and Minjur.
Waterlogging on the Poonamallee service road disrupted traffic and severely inconvenienced commuters.
Motor pumps were deployed in Gummidipoondi following news reports to clear accumulated rainwater.
Vultr and AMD announced plans to deploy AMD Instinct GPUs in a new 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai.
MeitY asked Meta to review content recommendation algorithms on Instagram and Facebook to curb misleading posts.
MeitY formed a team to investigate security risks after eMudhra issued certificates with weak secret keys.
Farmers' association members staged a road roko in Thiruvallur demanding complete cooperative crop loan waivers.
Allegations emerged regarding bribes allegedly taken from foreign firms for data centre and factory approvals.
Equinix India announced plans to expand its domestic data centre capacity with an eye on 70 MW.
